post.caption: Picasso's daughter turned scribbles into gold. In 1980, Tiffany launched Paloma Picasso's first jewelry collection, called Graffiti, inspired by graffiti on New York walls. Many pieces use her own handwriting, with an X for a kiss and an O for a hug. On an early visit, Tiffany laid out its colored gems on a table for her. Kunzite is named for Tiffany's own gem expert, George Kunz, and one of her necklaces holds a kunzite of 396 carats. It is kept at the Smithsonian's National Museum of Natural History. Paloma means dove in Spanish.
